# See through buildings

<!-- Generated by modules/core/tools/generate_index.py; edit the registry or the hooks, not these lines. -->

🗺 3D buildings with a shop or café inside are see-through, as in Apple Maps.

Switch `GroveSeeThrough`, on by default, after a restart. Off, or with Stock on, upstream's code runs.
